title: Former Tongyi Qianwen Leader Lin Junyang Officially Launches Startup Pragmatik Labs Secures Hundreds of Millions in Funding with a Valuation of 2 Billion

content_html:
Lin Junyang, former head of Alibaba's Qwen, recently officially announced his entrepreneurial activities on a foreign social platform, announcing the establishment of an AI laboratory called "Pragmatik Labs" (Chinese name: Yuyan Technology) in Shanghai.

The laboratory focuses on the research and development of next-generation AI agents that integrate the digital and physical worlds, aiming to create a general agent that can work in both virtual and real-world scenarios. Its core slogan is "Agents for digital and physical worlds."

At the same time, Lin Junyang revealed the initial funding round, which was jointly led by Gao Rong Capital and Sequoia China (HSG), with Tencent and the Shanghai Future Industry Fund also participating. Previous market reports indicated that the funding round reached hundreds of millions of dollars, with a post-money valuation of about $2 billion; Gao Rong and Sequoia each invested $100 million, while Tencent invested $20 million.

Previously, Lin Junyang announced his resignation as the head of Alibaba's Qwen large model on March 4 this year, followed by Alibaba CEO Wu Yongming's internal letter announcing the establishment of a foundational model support team. During his tenure at Alibaba, Lin Junyang led the development of the Qwen series models, the building of the open-source ecosystem, and the release of the trillion-parameter flagship model Qwen3-Max.

With the establishment of Pragmatik Labs, this top AI talent's entrepreneurial project will accelerate the deep penetration of general agents into the physical world.

content_html_zh:
阿里巴巴前掌门人Qwen林俊阳近日在国外社交平台正式宣布自己的创业活动，宣布在上海成立名为“Pragmatik Labs”（中文名：语言科技）的AI实验室。

该实验室专注于融合数字世界和物理世界的下一代人工智能代理的研发，旨在创建一个可以在虚拟和现实场景中工作的通用代理。 其核心口号是“数字和物理世界的代理”。

同时，林俊阳透露首轮融资由高榕资本和红杉中国（HSG）联合领投，腾讯、上海未来产业基金跟投。 此前市场报道显示，本轮融资金额达数亿美元，投后估值约20亿美元；高榕和红杉各投资1亿美元，腾讯投资2000万美元。

此前，林俊阳于今年3月4日宣布辞去阿里巴巴Qwen大模型负责人职务，随后阿里巴巴CEO吴永明内部信宣布成立基础模型支撑团队。 林俊阳在阿里巴巴任职期间，主导了Qwen系列模型的开发、开源生态的构建以及万亿参数旗舰模型Qwen3-Max的发布。

随着Pragmatik Labs的成立，这一顶尖AI人才的创业项目将加速总代理向物理世界的深度渗透。
